chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I used Itto - Oni Rush to deal 14 damage to Sludge Spinner, then All Streams Flow to the Sea to deal 13 damage, which was lethal.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing All Streams Flow to the Sea followed by both copies of Water's Edge, for 25 total damage and lethal.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 6 Block option on Itto - Oni Rush and the alternative line's two Water's Edge plays, in exchange for dealing 27 damage with two cards.
q4_different_intent: No. The chosen line defeats Sludge Spinner before its telegraphed action, so a different intent would not have changed my play.
